name: Sorano Fuu
source:
Position: Soldier 
Weapon: Kunai

A girl who decided to become a Tenshi to compensate for what her dead parents did in the past.
She always wears a necklace with a star shaped pendant which was the last present she received from her parents.
Her teammates believe she is a steady person who has a calm and composed nature.
Even if its just one star she will try her best to recover it, and with that goal set in mind she gives it her best.

[Edited from [url=http://cannonette.tumblr.com/post/90317810847/binary-star-main-characters]Cannonette[/url]]
